// Headgear -> costume table (pre-renewal). .map[<headgear item id>] = <costume twin item id> for every headgear of the era
// (the twin of the i-th headgear in ascending id order is 73000 + i). A headgear that fills several slots has one twin per
// slot: .map is the first one, .map2 / .map3 the others (they live in 73755-73881). The Costume Tailor reads this with
// getvariableofnpc, an array lookup, so finding the costumes of an item costs no loop (a script that loops too often
// is stopped by the server). db/item_db.yml in this folder holds the twins. Generated from the era's item database.

-	script	HTC_Table	-1,{
	end;

// Costume boxes: F_RndCostumeBox(slot) gives a random costume twin that has the slot: 1 = upper, 2 = middle, 3 = lower.
// The lists hold the twin item ids of this era (a costume with several slots is in each of its slots' lists).
